answer: Signatures are bridges, sold at auction rather than granted: each epoch a fixed number of them is released, and every answer needs five. Bidders pay the second-highest price, so a farm demanding five k bridges must outbid honest demand for each one, and the clearing price rises with its own appetite. A glacier of capital sits escrowed while the auction clears, and the ember of any unpaid bridge is burned rather than returned, so bidding sprees destroy value. Honest demand is one answer per agent, so the k-th clone pays the marginal price its own volume created.
